title: Taskflow Prompt Config
description: User-configurable settings that control agent role enforcement blocks and behavior.

gitTool.description: Which tool agents use for PR creation. 'gh' uses GitHub CLI; 'git' provides compare URLs for manual PR creation.

strictCLI.description: When true, agents must use insight-flow CLI for all task mutations and may not edit workTasks/ files directly.

prStrategy.description: PR state on creation. 'draft' opens a draft PR; 'ready' opens a ready-for-review PR.

branchPrefix.description: Optional prefix prepended to all branch names. E.g. 'team/' produces 'team/feat/N01-...' branches. Empty string disables prefix.

requireChecklist.description: When true, agents must verify all CHECKLIST.md items are checked before marking a task as implemented or done.
